notes: «يحيى ابنى سعيد»: the text gives «ابنى سعيد» as the patronymic of both «عبد ربه» and «يحيى»; only «يحيى» is written as the name
«مولى آل طلحة» is a descriptor of Muhammad b. Abd al-Rahman, not part of the name, so left out
«مثله ولم يذكر في حديثهم قول أبي سلمة» is a remark on the wording, not a route
«- يعني ...» none; the chain ends at the Companion Abu Qatada, the Prophet is not a link
